title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin slips 1.8% to $73,448 as extreme fear locks in at a 22 reading on the index. US morning action shows sellers pressing despite network strength, with hashrate steady at 949.1 EH/s. Mempool backs up to 121,321 transactions, though fees hold low at 3 sat/vB. Block 951,440 confirms without incident. No fresh catalysts, but the dip meets resilient fundamentals.
